text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Serving cluster 'us-east-1a' link degradation detected between rack-7 and rack-8. Packet loss spike >15% observed on IB fabric, correlated with container restarts and CUDA OOMs on gpu-pool-04. Auto-fallback to single-node serving triggered for some zones. Monitoring: increased 5xx rate from 0.4% -> 5.6% across model endpoints.
oncall-lina: Oncall here — acknowledging. Severity: P1? Any customer-reported impact yet?
sre-jordan: Seeing repeated retransmit alerts and QP error counters rising on mlx5_0. Logs from node gpu-07: `ib_read_err: qp 0x3fc4 transport timeout`, followed by container SIGKILL from OOM killer. Suspect packet reordering + backlog causing KV cache thrash and memory pressure.
eng-ryan: I can jump in. Which model shards were on gpu-07/gpu-08?
sre-jordan: gpu-07 had serving-group alpha-shard{12..15}. gpu-08 similar. Both showed high tail latency then OOMs.
platform-simone: Quick mitigation options: 1) Drain affected nodes from serving pool (fast). 2) Force software fallback to TCP between pods (slower, config change). 3) Increase KV cache eviction to reduce memory pressure (risky).
oncall-lina: Start with drain + routing fallback to healthy racks. Can someone run cordon + drain for gpu-07/08?
sre-jordan: Doing cordon/drain now. Command:```kubectl cordon gpu-07 && kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n serving```Keeping an eye on pod reschedules.
eng-ryan: I'll push a temporary routing policy to route new requests away from rack-7/8. Applying config:```curl -X POST "$REDWOOD_CONTROL/api/v1/routing" -d '{"policy":"avoid_racks","racks":["rack-7","rack-8"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"``` Should be immediate for new traffic.
support-anna: Notifying affected customers: queued notice to customers with active sessions in those racks. cc @customer-kenneth for one impacted account.
customer-kenneth: We saw spikes in 5xx on our end — redirecting flows helped but some long-running requests failed. Please keep us updated, SLA impact?
oncall-lina: SLA assessment in flight. For now assume degraded latency and transient 5xxs; we'll estimate minutes of impact after stabilization.
sre-jordan: After drains, packet loss on mlx5_0 dropped from 18% -> 3% on monitoring probe. However, we still see occasional IB timeouts and one node (gpu-09) logging `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` during migration. Might be related to corrupted KV cache state.
eng-ryan: Rolling restarts of serving containers on recovered nodes to clear caches. Command run:```kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving-runtime -n serving --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-09```
platform-simone: Also toggled fallback route to TCP as a safeguard: set `fabric_fallback: tcp` in the control plane for serving-runtime. This will increase latency ~10-20% but reduce cross-node IB pressure.
sre-jordan: Observed reduction in container restarts after restart + TCP fallback. OOMs stopped on restarted pods. Monitoring shows 5xx down to 0.9% and p95 latency stable.
sre-jordan: Post-mit note: need to schedule firmware/driver upgrade for mlx5_0 and a review of our multipath settings — current ECMP config may amplify loss under microbursts.
oncall-lina: Preparing handoff to night oncall. Current status: traffic routed away from rack-7/8, TCP fallback enabled, drained problematic nodes, customer notices sent. Severity lowered to P2.
oncall-lina: Handoff to eng-ryan for follow-up (bugs/driver + perf tradeoffs). ETA: engineer oncall accepted.
eng-ryan: Taking it. Will coordinate driver upgrade window and run a KV cache integrity check. Also will prepare a canary to revert TCP fallback once fabric stable.
support-anna: I'll follow up with affected customers with a summary and ETA for permanent fix.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed to "mitigated" by oncall-lina at 1755010800.
eng-ryan: Quick note: found repeated MKey timeout entries in kernel logs — file attached to ticket INFRA-1342. Plan: schedule rolling driver/firmware update + run synthetic microburst tests.
platform-simone: Add a temporary alert rule to detect >5% packet loss across any rack for 5m so we get earlier paging.
sre-jordan: Agree. Will tune alert thresholds and add a playbook step: automatically throttle cross-rack KV cache prefetch during IB instability.
eng-ryan: Leaving detailed runbook steps in the ticket and will follow up in the postmortem.
customer-kenneth: Thanks for the quick response — we'll watch for updates and appreciate the communication.
oncall-lina: Handoff complete. If anything regresses, page SRE and escalate to on-call eng. :thumbsup:
